666.name: Metaphysical Rejuvenation
666.description: Grant regeneration to nearby allies when you use a healing skill.

667.name: Illusionary Membrane
667.description: Gain chaos aura when you use your Shatter skill 2. Chaos aura grants you increased condition damage for a period of time.

668.name: Chaotic Transference
668.description: Gaining chaos aura grants boons to nearby allies.

669.name: Chaotic Interruption
669.description:
When you interrupt a foe, recharge one of your equipped-weapon skills at random.
Only affects weapon skills that are recharging.

670.name: Method of Madness
670.description: Cast Lesser Chaos Storm when you use a healing skill.

671.name: Shaper of Chaos
671.description: When you grant yourself chaos aura, if you already have chaos aura, detonate your chaos aura to grant yourself boons and inflict conditions on enemies.

673.name: Auspicious Anguish
673.description:
Convert damaging conditions to boons whenever you gain Distortion or become disabled.
This trait can only trigger when disabled once per interval.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

674.name: Prismatic Understanding
674.description: Increased stealth duration from mesmer skills. Shatter skill 4 grants stealth. Gain regeneration upon entering stealth, and gain protection and resolution upon exiting stealth.

675.name: Illusionary Defense
675.description: Grant protection to nearby allies when you use Shatter skill 2.

677.name: Master of Manipulation
677.description: <c=@abilitytype>Manipulations</c> grant aegis to yourself and nearby allies.

680.name: Mental Anguish
680.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills deal more damage. This bonus damage is doubled against foes that are not activating skills.

681.name: Vicious Expression
681.description:
You and your illusions deal increased strike damage. Strike damage is further increased against foes without boons. Disabling a foe removes boons from them.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

685.name: Illusion of Vulnerability
685.description:
Inflict vulnerability when you interrupt a foe.
This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

686.name: Bountiful Blades
686.description: Improves greatsword skills. Mirror Blade bounces additional times, and Phantasmal Berserker summons an additional berserker and deals less damage.

691.name: The Pledge
691.description: Flame bursts from torch skills inflict additional burning.

692.name: Superiority Complex
692.description:
Your critical hits deal more damage. Critical hit damage against disabled foes, or foes below the health threshold, is further increased.
Disabled foes are affected by stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, fear, taunt, or launch.

693.name: Shattered Concentration
693.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills also remove a boon on hit.

694.name: Dazzling
694.description:
Disabling a foe also applies vulnerability.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

700.name: Duelist's Discipline
700.description:
Interrupting a foe recharges pistol skills.
This trait can only reduce recharge on enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

704.name: Deceptive Evasion
704.description: Create a clone at your current position when you dodge.

705.name: Mental Gymnastics
705.description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

706.name: Critical Infusion
706.description: Gain vigor when delivering a critical hit.

707.name: Master Fencer
707.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

708.name: Fencer's Finesse
708.description: Gain a stacking ferocity effect when you or one of your illusions strikes with a one-handed sword or an underwater spear. Reduces recharge on sword and underwater spear skills.

710.name: Sharper Images
710.description: Illusions inflict bleeding on critical hits.

712.name: Furious Interruption
712.description: Gain quickness when you interrupt a foe.

713.name: Egotism
713.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with a lower health percentage than you.

721.name: Shatter Storm
721.description: Shatter skill 1 becomes an ammo skill.

722.name: Escape Artist
722.description: When a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c> is created, grant it distortion.

723.name: Compounding Power
723.description: Creating an illusion increases your outgoing damage and condition damage for a short duration.

729.name: Phantasmal Haste
729.description: <c=@abilitytype>Phantasms</c> spawn with quickness. Gain quickness when you create a phantasm.

733.name: Phantasmal Force
733.description: <c=@abilitytype>Phantasms</c> deal increased strike damage for each stack of might you have. Gain might when your phantasms become clones.

734.name: Cry of Pain
734.description: Shatter skill 2 inflicts more stacks of confusion for an increased duration.

738.name: Restorative Mantras
738.description: Heals allies around you when you use a charge of a <c=@abilitytype>mantra</c>.

740.name: Ego Restoration
740.description: Create a clone when you use a healing skill.

744.name: Sympathetic Visage
744.description: <c=@abilitytype>Phantasms</c> take conditions from you when summoned.

751.name: Warden's Feedback
751.description: Focus weapon skills reflect projectiles. Reduces recharge on focus weapon skills.

752.name: Blurred Inscriptions
752.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> have improved active effects, and activating one grants you distortion.

753.name: Malicious Sorcery
753.description: Confusion you inflict has increased duration. When you dodge an attack, inflict confusion on your attacker.

756.name: Medic's Feedback
756.description: Cast Feedback while reviving an ally. Feedback revives allies inside its dome.

757.name: Mender's Purity
757.description: Cast Lesser Power Cleanse when you use a healing skill.

1687.name: Bountiful Disillusionment
1687.description: Gain stability when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skill. Grant an additional boon to nearby allies based on which <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> is used.

1688.name: Power Block
1688.description:
Interrupts deal damage and inflict weakness while granting you a damage increase.
This trait can only damage enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1838.name: Delayed Reactions
1838.description:
Disabling a foe slows them.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.
This trait can only affect the same enemy with once per interval.

1852.name: Inspiring Distortion
1852.description: Grant aegis to other nearby allies whenever you give yourself distortion or use Shatter skill 4.

1859.name: Time Marches On
1859.description: You move 25% faster. Alacrity applied to you is stronger.

1865.name: Chaotic Persistence
1865.description: Gain concentration and expertise while affected by regeneration.

1866.name: Restorative Illusions
1866.description: Heal and cleanse conditions from yourself and nearby allies when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skill.

1869.name: Persistence of Memory
1869.description: When a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c> becomes a clone, it transfers its boons to you.

1890.name: Chronophantasma
1890.description:
The first time a phantasm would become a clone, it instead resummons itself and attacks again. Resummoned phantasms inflict a percentage of the original's damage.
(Resummoned phantasms are briefly dazed.)

1913.name: Illusionary Reversion
1913.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills generate a clone and grant alacrity if you have enough clones present.

1915.name: Illusionary Inspiration
1915.description:
Increase healing to other allies. Summoning an illusion heals all allies around you.

Virtuoso: Triggers when stocking a blade.

1927.name: Flow of Time
1927.description: Gain alacrity for each clone you shatter. Gain increased critical-strike chance for you and your illusions when you have alacrity.

1941.name: Fragility
1941.description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of vulnerability on your target.

1942.name: Stretched Time
1942.description: Nearby allies gain boons for each clone you shatter. Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c>.

1950.name: Ineptitude
1950.description:
Interrupting a foe inflicts blind, and blinding a foe inflicts confusion.
This trait can only activate on enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1960.name: Wandering Mind
1960.description: Remove a nondamaging condition and gain swiftness whenever you evade an attack.

1978.name: Time Bomb
1978.description:
Enemies struck by Time Sink are affixed with a time bomb. Time bombs increase your strike damage dealt to the target and explode when they expire.
Only a certain number of time bombs may be active at once.

1980.name: Temporal Enchanter
1980.description: When you cast a <c=abilitytype>glamour</c>, allies near the glamour gain resistance and superspeed.

1995.name: Time Catches Up
1995.description: Activating a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> gives your illusions superspeed. Shatters deal increased damage to movement-impaired foes.

2005.name: Mental Defense
2005.description: Shatter skill 4 grants boons and breaks allies out of stuns.

2009.name: Danger Time
2009.description: When you inflict slow, you and your illusions' outgoing critical-strike damage is increased for a duration.

2022.name: Seize the Moment
2022.description: You and nearby allies gain quickness for each clone you <c=@abilitytype>shatter</c>. Grant quickness to nearby allies when you summon a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c>.

2030.name: Time Splitter
2030.description: Gain access to chronomancer shatter skills and <c=@abilitytype>Wells</c>.

2069.name: Nomad's Endurance
2069.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills give vigor. Strike and condition damage dealt is increased when you have vigor.

2070.name: Infinite Horizon
2070.description: When you gain Mirage Cloak, your illusions also gain it.

2082.name: Renewing Oasis
2082.description: Gain regeneration when you gain Mirage Cloak. The duration of incoming damaging conditions is reduced while you are regenerating.

2098.name: Phantom Pain
2098.description: Gain a damage increase when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skill, increasing per clone shattered.

2110.name: Riddle of Sand
2110.description: When entering combat, your first <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> attack applies confusion. This ability refreshes when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skill.

2113.name: Elusive Mind
2113.description: Lose conditions when you gain Mirage Cloak.

2117.name: Speed of Sand
2117.description: Mirage Cloak increases your movement speed.

2141.name: Self-Deception
2141.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>Deception</c> skill will create a clone if you have any other clones active.

2150.name: Mirage Cloak
2150.description: Gain Mirage Cloak instead of dodge rolling. <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> skills become available for a short time whenever you gain Mirage Cloak. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Deception</c> skills.

2169.name: Dune Cloak
2169.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills grant Mirage Cloak if you have enough clones present. Gaining Mirage Cloak recharges Mind Wrack and Cry of Frustration.

2174.name: Mirage Mantle
2174.description: <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> skills you use grant boons to nearby allies.

2178.name: Desert Distortion
2178.description: Illusions shattered by Distortion become Mirage Mirrors. <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> skills become available for a short time whenever you grant distortion to yourself.

2193.name: Quiet Intensity
2193.description: Fury gives an increased critical hit chance. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

2202.name: Jagged Mind
2202.description: <c=@abilitytype>Blade</c> attacks inflict bleeding on critical hits. A percentage of your condition damage dealt heals you.

2204.name: Deadly Blades
2204.description: <c=@abilitytype>Blades</c> inflict vulnerability on critical hits. After successfully casting a <c=@abilitytype>Bladesong</c>, increase all damage dealt for a short time. This does not stack.

2205.name: Phantasmal Blades
2205.description: Phantasms that successfully complete their attack launch a blade at their target and grant you fury when they expire.

2206.name: Infinite Forge
2206.description: Automatically stock <c=@abilitytype>blades</c> while in combat. When you use a <c=@abilitytype>bladesong</c> above the blade threshold, refund <c=@abilitytype>blades</c>. <c=@abilitytype>Blade</c> attacks deal more damage.

2207.name: Sharpening Sorrow
2207.description: Gain fury when you activate Bladesong Sorrow. Fury increases your expertise.

2208.name: Mental Focus
2208.description: Strike damage is increased against foes within the range threshold.

2211.name: Psychic Riposte
2211.description: Blocking or evading an attack stocks <c=@abilitytype>blades</c>. Dodging stocks a blade.

2215.name: Duelist's Reversal
2215.description: Blocking or dodging an attack grants boons.

2216.name: Psychic Blades
2216.description:
Whenever a clone would be summoned, you instead stock a blade. Blades persist indefinitely until used. Your shatters are replaced with Bladesongs that consume your stocked blades, but still count as shatters for the purposes of core traits.

While out of combat, you will automatically stock a blade every 10 seconds.

2223.name: Bloodsong
2223.description: Bleeding you apply deals increased damage. Stock a <c=@abilitytype>blade</c> after applying enough stacks of bleeding to foes.

2326.name: Raconteur
2326.description: <c=@abilitytype>Tales</c> heal and grant protection to nearby allies.

2343.name: Shredding
2343.description: Lively Lute fires an additional wave at your enemy. The lute's damage bonus is increased.

2353.name: Fortissimo
2353.description: After using Crescendo, gain a note every interval for a duration. Gain increased attributes for each instrument you have playing.

2367.name: Life of the Party
2367.description: Lively Lute and Crescendo grant boons to affected allies.

2374.name: Harmonize
2374.description: Gain a note when you use a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c> skill.

2386.name: Wandering Minstrel
2386.description:
Build up notes instead of summoning clones. Shatters are replaced by Instrument skills, which consume notes to continue playing. Gain access to Tales.

While out of combat, you will automatically generate a note every 10 seconds.

2414.name: Call and Response
2414.description: When you use an instrument above the note threshold, create an afterimage that plays that instrument after a delay.

2422.name: Love Song
2422.description: Harmonious Harp's distortion lasts longer. Strike damage from nearby enemies is reduced while the harp is playing in the background.

2424.name: Symphonic Resonance
2424.description: Instruments provide bonuses while playing in the background.

2427.name: Mayhem
2427.description: Flustering Flute now applies torment. Dodging reduces the recharge of Flustering Flute.

2432.name: Syncopate
2432.description: Deafening Drum releases an additional quick wave after a delay. Deal damage to enemies you disable.

2441.name: Altered Chord
2441.description: Crescendo prompts your last-played instrument to take the spotlight, augmenting Crescendo's effects. Playing an instrument recharges Crescendo if a note was consumed.

10168.name: Confusing Images
10168.description: Channel a beam of energy that damages and confuses your foe.

10169.name: Chaos Storm
10169.description: Create a magical storm at the target location that applies random conditions to foes and boons to allies. The first strike of the storm dazes foes.

10170.name: Mind Slash
10170.description: Chain. Slash your foe to make them vulnerable.

10171.name: Mind Gash
10171.description: Chain. Gash your foe to make them vulnerable.

10172.name: Mind Spike
10172.description: Stab your foe and rip a boon off of them. Does additional damage when the target has no boons.

10173.name: Illusionary Leap
10173.description: Clone. Summon an illusion that leaps at your target, crippling them. After the initial leap, the clone will execute the Mind Slash sword chain.

10174.name: Phantasmal Swordsman
10174.description: Phantasm. Perform a sword strike and create an illusion that attacks your foe. If the sword strike hits, you gain might.

10175.name: Phantasmal Duelist
10175.description: Phantasm. Fire multiple crippling bullets at your target and summon an illusion that unloads its pistols on your target.

10176.name: Ether Feast
10176.description: Heal yourself and remove conditions. Gain additional health and remove additional conditions for each active clone.

10177.name: Mirror
10177.description: Manipulation. Reflect projectiles, and heal yourself.

10185.name: Arcane Thievery
10185.description: Manipulation. Send conditions you have to your foe and steal their boons. Successfully hitting your target inflicts slow on them while granting you quickness.

10186.name: Temporal Curtain
10186.description: Create a wall of energy that grants swiftness to allies who cross it and cripples foes who touch it. Allies may cross the wall more than once but receive less swiftness after the first crossing.

10187.name: Veil
10187.description: Glamour. Create a wall that grants stealth to you and your allies.

10189.name: Phantasmal Mage
10189.description: Phantasm. Strike and burn nearby foes. Create an illusion that releases a massive wave of fire that burns, confuses, and interrupts foes.

10190.name: Cry of Frustration
10190.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, confusing nearby foes. The shatter effect also occurs at your location.

10191.name: Mind Wrack
10191.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, damaging nearby foes. The shatter effect also occurs at your location.

10192.name: Distortion
10192.description: Shatter. Gain distortion and destroy all your clones, gaining additional distortion for each one shattered.

10197.name: Portal Entre
10197.description:
Glamour. Create an entry portal at your location that teleports allies to your exit portal.
(Creating a new entrance portal while you have an active portal will destroy the active portal.)

10200.name: Blink
10200.description: Manipulation. Teleport to a target location.

10201.name: Decoy
10201.description: Clone. Gain stealth and summon an illusion to attack your foe.

10202.name: Mirror Images
10202.description: Clone. Summon two clones to attack your foe.

10203.name: Null Field
10203.description: Glamour. Create a field of energy that rips boons from foes and cures conditions on allies.

10204.name: Mantra of Distraction
10204.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will daze your target. Shatter skill 3's recharge time is partially refunded when this spell fully charges.

10206.name: Power Lock
10206.description: Daze your target and nearby foes.

10207.name: Mantra of Resolve
10207.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will cure conditions for you and nearby allies. Cure conditions on yourself and nearby allies when this spell is fully charged.

10209.name: Power Cleanse
10209.description: Remove conditions from you and nearby allies.

10211.name: Mantra of Pain
10211.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will damage your target. Grant might to nearby allies when this spell is fully charged.

10212.name: Power Spike
10212.description: Damage your target and nearby foes. Inflict vulnerability on foes whose skills aren't active.

10213.name: Mantra of Recovery
10213.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will instantly heal you when activated. Heal yourself and nearby allies when this spell fully charges.

10214.name: Power Return
10214.description: Instantly heal yourself. Receive increased healing if you are below the health threshold.

10216.name: Phantasmal Warlock
10216.description: Phantasm. Summon illusions that deal damage and inflict conditions.

10218.name: Mind Stab
10218.description: Stab an illusionary greatsword through the ground to cripple foes at your targeted location. This skill deals increased damage against vulnerable foes.

10219.name: Spatial Surge
10219.description: Shoot a beam at your foe. The farther away they are, the more damage you deal.

10220.name: Illusionary Wave
10220.description: Knock back foes with a wave of magical energy.

10221.name: Phantasmal Berserker
10221.description: Phantasm. Throw an illusionary greatsword at your foe, removing boons from struck enemies. Create a phantasm that whirls through foes.

10229.name: Magic Bullet
10229.description: Hit up to four foes with a single shot, inflicting confusion on each foe. In addition, the first target is stunned, the second is dazed, and the third is blinded.

10232.name: Signet of Domination
10232.description:
Signet Passive: Improved condition damage.
Signet Active: Stun your foe.

10234.name: Signet of Midnight
10234.description:
Signet Passive: Improves expertise.
Signet Active: Blind nearby foes and stealth yourself.

10236.name: Signet of Inspiration
10236.description:
Signet Passive: Grant swiftness and an additional random boon every ten seconds.
Signet Active: Extends the duration of all boons on yourself.

10237.name: Mantra of Concentration
10237.description: Mantra. Meditate, charging a spell that will break stuns and grant stability to nearby allies. Grant boons to nearby allies when this spell fully charges.

10238.name: Power Break
10238.description: Break stuns on yourself and grant stability to nearby allies.

10244.name: Illusion of Life
10244.description: Manipulation. Give allies Illusion of Life at the target location, allowing them to get up from downed state and keep fighting. Fully revives allies if they kill a foe.

10245.name: Mass Invisibility
10245.description: Manipulation. You and all your allies gain stealth for a short time.

10247.name: Signet of Illusions
10247.description:
Signet Passive: Creates a clone every few seconds.
Signet Active: Recharges shatter skills.

10251.name: Phantasmal Mariner
10251.description: Phantasm. Perform an evasive strike and create an illusion that evades while attacking your foe in a flurry.

10255.name: Vortex
10255.description: Create a vortex at your location, pulling nearby foes toward you.

10258.name: Siren's Call
10258.description: Unleash sonic energy that bounces between multiple foes, damaging and bleeding them. When it hits allies, it applies might, vigor, or swiftness.

10259.name: Blinding Tide
10259.description: Expose your enemies, inflicting vulnerability in an area.

10260.name: Illusion of Drowning
10260.description: Sink enemies around your target with an illusionary anchor.

10267.name: Phantasmal Disenchanter
10267.description: Phantasm. Summon an illusion that removes boons from targets it hits. This attack deals increased damage against foes without boons.

10273.name: Winds of Chaos
10273.description: Bounce an orb of energy between foes and allies. The first hit applies torment, while subsequent hits to enemies apply confusion. Allies that the orb bounces to gain fury and might.

10276.name: Illusionary Counter
10276.description: Clone. Block the next attack, and counter by inflicting torment and creating clones that cast Ether Bolt.

10280.name: Illusionary Riposte
10280.description: Clone. Block your foe and create an illusion when attacked.

10282.name: Phantasmal Warden
10282.description: Phantasm. Create a phantasm that throws axes at nearby targets and creates a defensive bubble, protecting itself and allies from projectiles.

10285.name: The Prestige
10285.description: Disappear in a cloud of smoke, blinding nearby foes and losing conditions. Reappear three seconds later, burning nearby foes.

10287.name: Diversion
10287.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, dazing their targets. The shatter effect also occurs at your location.

10289.name: Ether Bolt
10289.description: Chain. Shoot a bolt of energy at your target.

10290.name: Ether Blast
10290.description: Chain. Shoot a second bolt of energy at your target.

10291.name: Ether Clone
10291.description: Clone. Deliver a damaging attack directly to your target. Summon a clone that casts Ether Bolt. Inflict torment instead if you have the maximum number of illusions.

10302.name: Feedback
10302.description: Glamour. Create a dome around your foes that reflects projectiles.

10310.name: Phase Retreat
10310.description: Clone. Teleport away from your target, summoning a clone that casts Winds of Chaos.

10311.name: Time Warp
10311.description: Glamour. Create an area that warps time, granting you and your allies quickness while slowing enemies.

10314.name: Counterspell
10314.description: Shoot out a bolt that blinds enemies in a line and summons a clone to attack the first foe it strikes.

10317.name: Evasive Strike
10317.description: Evade while delivering a powerful final attack.

10318.name: Feigned Surge
10318.description: Clone. Surge toward your foe, striking enemies on the way and creating a clone upon reaching your initial target.

10325.name: Slipstream
10325.description: Create a current at your location that immobilizes enemies entering it and grants superspeed to allies passing through it.

10327.name: Imminent Voyage
10327.description: Clone. Retreat back, summoning a clone to attack your foe while granting chaos armor to nearby allies.

10328.name: Phantasmal Whaler
10328.description: Phantasm. Cast Siren's Call on nearby foes and create an illusion that confuses foes with a harpoon gun.

10331.name: Chaos Armor
10331.description: Blind and confuse nearby foes while you gain chaos aura. Chaos aura grants you a random boon and inflicts your foe with a random condition whenever you are struck.

10333.name: Mirror Blade
10333.description: Throw an illusionary blade that creates a clone at its first target and then bounces to enemies and allies, dealing less damage to foes per bounce and granting might to allies.

10334.name: Blurred Frenzy
10334.description: Strike your foe with a flurry of strikes, distorting the space around you, making you evade attacks.

10337.name: Swap
10337.description: Swap places with your clone. Immobilize nearby foes.

10341.name: Phantasmal Defender
10341.description: Phantasm. Summon an illusion that taunts your target and all nearby targets while blocking. When it finishes blocking, the illusion explodes, dealing increased damage for each attack it blocked.

10356.name: Feedback
10356.description: Glamour. Create a dome around you that reflects projectiles.

10358.name: Counter Blade
10358.description: Shoot out a bolt that dazes foes in a line.

10363.name: Into the Void
10363.description: Shatter your Temporal Curtain, pulling nearby enemies toward its position.

13733.name: Lesser Chaos Storm
13733.description: Create a magical storm at the target location that applies random conditions to foes and boons to allies.

21750.name: Signet of the Ether
21750.description:
Signet Passive: Heal yourself whenever you summon an illusion.
Signet Active: Heal yourself and reduce the recharge of phantasm skills.

24755.name: Thousand Cuts
24755.description: Psionic. Open a portal that devastates targets in a line in front of you with a flurry of blades.

25513.name: Phantasmal Blade
25513.description: Shoots a blade at the phantasm's current target.

29519.name: Signet of Humility
29519.description:
Signet Passive: Reduces duration of incoming stuns, dazes, fears, and taunts.
Signet Active: Transform your foe into a moa bird.
(Defiant foes will have their defiant bar reduced instead.)

29526.name: Well of Precognition
29526.description: Well. Create a well that gives allies the ability to see the future, allowing them to block incoming attacks. When the well ends, allies within the well regain endurance.

29578.name: Mimic
29578.description:
Manipulation. The next utility skill you use has significantly reduced recharge, and Mimic's recharge is increased by the original recharge of the affected skill.
Mimic's recharge cannot be reset by other mesmer skills.

29649.name: Deja Vu
29649.description: Phantasm. Block incoming attacks for a short duration. If this skill fully channels, summon a phantasm that slows enemies and grants protection to allies. If an attack is blocked, the phantasm is summoned immediately.

29830.name: Continuum Split
29830.description:
Destroy all your clones and create a rift in the space-time continuum. When it expires, you will revert back to your original point with your previous health, endurance, and skill recharges. Duration increases with each illusion shattered.
This skill's recharge cannot be reset by other mesmer skills.

29856.name: Well of Senility
29856.description: Well. Creates a well that steals memories from foes, damaging and chilling them. When it expires, foes still inside the well have boons removed from them.

30166.name: Lesser Power Cleanse
30166.description: Remove conditions from you and nearby allies.

30305.name: Well of Eternity
30305.description: Well. Create a well that rewinds time, removing conditions from allies. When it expires, the well heals all allies in the area.

30359.name: Gravity Well
30359.description: Well. Create a powerful well that warps space in an area, knocking down, floating, and pulling foes caught in its event horizon. When it expires, foes still inside the well take heavy damage.

30525.name: Well of Calamity
30525.description: Well. Create a well that rends time, damaging, weakening, and crippling foes in the area. When the final pulse of Well of Calamity triggers, it deals massive damage to foes in the area.

30643.name: Tides of Time
30643.description: Grant boons to nearby allies as you launch a wave of temporal energy that damages and stops enemies it passes through, then returns to you. Touching the returning wave reduces the recharge of this skill.

30747.name: Continuum Shift
30747.description: Revert back to the previous timeline. Your health, endurance and cooldowns are reverted to their previous states. You are transported back prematurely if the rift is destroyed.

30769.name: Echo of Memory
30769.description: Phantasm. Block incoming attacks for a short duration. If this skill fully channels, summon a phantasm that slows enemies and grants protection to allies. If an attack is blocked, Deja Vu is usable for a short time and the phantasm is summoned immediately.

30814.name: Well of Action
30814.description: Well. Create a well of delayed time, damaging and slowing foes. When the well expires, time snaps back, granting boons to allies.

35637.name: Sword of Decimation
35637.description:
Psionic. Drop a massive blade on a location, immobilizing enemies. This attack deals increased damage against controlled, downed, or defiant foes. Does bonus defiance-bar damage to defiant foes.
Controls include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

39959.name: Wave of Panic
39959.description: Ambush. Release a wave of energy that interrupts and confuses foes.

40184.name: Chaos Vortex
40184.description:
Ambush. Release a vortex of chaos energy that inflicts damaging conditions on foes. Allies near you gain boons. 
Clones using this attack grant their boons around you instead of themselves.

40200.name: False Oasis
40200.description: Deception. Create a mirage at your current location and heal over time. When the mirage expires, it spawns a mirage mirror.

41065.name: Crystal Sands
41065.description: Deception. Draw in shards of crystal sand that confuse foes they pass through on their way to your targeted location. The shards form a Mirage Mirror upon reaching their destination.

41164.name: Mirror Strikes
41164.description: Inflict bleeding and torment on your target.

42183.name: Reformed Mirage Mirror
42183.description: Your shattered illusion reforms into a mirror. Touching the mirror shatters it, granting mirage cloak to you and weakening foes.

42304.name: Ether Barrage
42304.description: Ambush. Launch a barrage of chaos orbs at your foe, inflicting confusion and torment. Condition duration halved for clones.

42851.name: Mirage Advance
42851.description: Deception. Shadowstep and unleash an attack that blinds and dazes your target and nearby foes. You may reactivate this skill to return to your original position.

43064.name: Sand through Glass
43064.description: Deception. Evade backward and gain Mirage Cloak.

43343.name: Blade Renewal
43343.description: Psionic. Channel to gain distortion and stock up to the maximum number of blades.

43761.name: Axes of Symmetry
43761.description: You and all your axe clones shadowstep to a random location around your target and strike, applying confusion. This attack breaks enemy targeting, and your illusions change focus to the targeted foe.

44241.name: Split Surge
44241.description: Ambush. Shoot a beam at a targeted foe, and secondary beams at foes near your target.

44321.name: Imaginary Axes
44321.description: Ambush. Release phantasmal axes that seek out the nearest target after a short delay.

44864.name: Ambush Assault
44864.description: Ambush. Blink to your target and unleash a series of low-damage strikes that rapidly stack vulnerability.

45046.name: Illusionary Ambush
45046.description: Deception. You and all your illusions shadowstep to a random point around your target and gain Mirage Cloak. Illusions' actions are interrupted when they change focus to the targeted foe.

45230.name: Mirage Thrust
45230.description: Ambush. Lunge at your foe and strike them with your sword, briefly dazing them. Leave behind a clone at your original location.

45243.name: Lingering Thoughts
45243.description: Spin forward and strike multiple times, inflicting conditions and leaving a mirage at your starting position. If an enemy is near the mirage when it expires, a clone is summoned.

45425.name: Rain of Swords
45425.description: Psionic. Create a storm of blades that attacks a large area, damaging and applying vulnerability to targets.

45449.name: Jaunt
45449.description: Deception. Shadowstep to a target location and confuse nearby foes.

45666.name: Mirage Retreat
45666.description: Return to your starting point and leave behind a clone at your previous location.

49068.name: Mind Wrack
49068.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, damaging nearby foes. The shatter effect also occurs at your location.

56873.name: Time Sink
56873.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, dazing and slowing their targets.

56925.name: Split Second
56925.description:
Shatter. Destroy all your clones, damaging nearby foes. Strikes again after a delay.
Shatter traits only affect the first strike of this skill.

56928.name: Rewinder
56928.description: Shatter. Destroy all your clones, confusing nearby foes and recharging this skill for each clone shattered.

56930.name: Split Second
56930.description:
Shatter. Destroy all your clones, damaging nearby foes. Strikes again after a delay.
Shatter traits only affect the first strike of this skill.

62510.name: Flying Cutter
62510.description: Send a blade of energy at your target. Hitting the same target multiple times invokes a flurry of blades on your target.

62522.name: Twin Blade Restoration
62522.description: Psionic. Heal yourself, lose conditions, and throw two blades at your target. If the first blade hits, you gain aegis. If the second blade hits, you gain vigor.

62560.name: Bladecall
62560.description: Throw a fan of daggers that return to you. If your target is in range, the returning daggers will lock on to that target. Create a clone if this attack hits at least one target.

62568.name: Blade Leap
62568.description: Leap to your target and summon a clone if you hit. Can be recast to return to your starting point.

62573.name: Psychic Force
62573.description: Psionic. Channel energy into your blades to damage nearby enemies and make your next bladesong unblockable.

62586.name: Bladesong Harmony
62586.description: Bladesong. Fire all stocked blades at your target.

62597.name: Bladeturn Requiem
62597.description: Bladesong.Send your blades spinning around you to hit nearby foes. Spinning blade duration scales with number of blades consumed.

62602.name: Bladesong Dissonance
62602.description: Bladesong. Combine all your blades into one large blade that dazes targets based on the number of blades consumed.

62607.name: Unstable Bladestorm
62607.description: Create a telekinetic storm of daggers that damages foes. With each interval, the bladestorm will fire blades at nearby enemies.

62616.name: Bladesong Sorrow
62616.description: Bladesong. Fire all stocked blades, inflicting your target with conditions.

62617.name: Bladesong Harmony
62617.description: Bladesong. Fire all stocked blades at your target.

62675.name: Returning Edge
62675.description: Shadowstep back to your previous location, crippling foes as you retreat.

68273.name: Bladesong Distortion
68273.description: Bladesong. Gain distortion and consume all stocked blades, gaining additional distortion for each consumed blade.

69311.name: Bladecall
69311.description: Throw a fan of daggers that return to you. Summon a clone if this attack hits at least one target.

69344.name: Lingering Thoughts
69344.description: Spin forward and strike multiple times, inflicting conditions. Summon a clone if you hit at least one target.

69385.name: Axes of Symmetry
69385.description: Shadowstep to a random location around your target and strike, applying confusion. Apply extra stacks of confusion per active clone. This attack breaks enemy targeting, and your illusions change focus to the targeted foe.

69389.name: Phantom Razor
69389.description: Ambush. Slice your foe with a flurry of blades. Each blade inflicts different conditions.

71792.name: Dimensional Aperture
71792.description: Collapse your singularity, creating a single-use portal that will teleport the user to your current location. Increase the cooldown of Singularity Shot.

71800.name: Effervescence
71800.description: Ambush. Spray invigorating magic, damaging enemies and healing allies.

71892.name: Friendly Fire
71892.description: Shoot an illusionary bullet that heals nearby allies on impact.

71897.name: Journey
71897.description: Clone. Shoot a bullet through a portal. It reappears above the target location and explodes, damaging enemies and healing allies. Create a clone if you hit an enemy or ally.

72005.name: Inspiring Imagery
72005.description: Throw an inspiring beacon to a target location. The beacon will explode after a short duration, granting boons to nearby allies. The beacon can be detonated early to heal allies and damage enemies.

72007.name: Phantasmal Sharpshooter
72007.description: Phantasm. Create a phantasm that shoots a bullet at your target, stunning them.

72008.name: Singularity Shot
72008.description: Shoot a bullet at a target location that explodes upon arrival, granting resistance and barrier to allies. A singularity lingers at the impact point.

72076.name: Abstraction
72076.description: Detonate your beacon, debilitating enemies and bolstering allies.

72946.name: Phantasmal Lancer
72946.description: Dash at your foe, removing boons from them. Leave a phantasm at your initial location that will launch a spear at your target, dealing heavy damage and crippling targets. If your phantasm strikes a crippled target, immobilize them instead. If you have Clarity, summon an additional phantasm.

72957.name: Mental Collapse
72957.description: Teleport to your target and release a cascade of psychic energy, damaging nearby enemies. Refresh your Mind the Gap skill. The initial impact stuns foes struck if you have Clarity.

73066.name: Psystrike
73066.description: Rend your foe with an upward swing. Gain might per target struck.

73067.name: Fractured Glass
73067.description: Ambush. Pierce targets in front of you in a flurry of blows, leaving them vulnerable.

73093.name: Mind the Gap
73093.description: Swing your spear in a circle, dealing increased damage to foes in the outer edge. Striking with the outer edge will always deal a critical hit. Create a clone and gain Clarity if you hit an enemy. If you are empowered, gain might.

73095.name: Mind Pierce
73095.description: Deliver a finishing thrust, breaking your opponent's mind and inflicting weakness.

73152.name: Imaginary Inversion
73152.description: Cleanse conditions and evade while preparing a strong attack. If you successfully evade, heal yourself. Healing is improved if you have Clarity.

73154.name: Psycut
73154.description: Slash your spear in front of yourself. Gain might per target struck.

76552.name: Lively Lute
76552.description:
Instrument. Perform with your lute, sending out damaging sound waves toward an enemy and healing tones toward allies.
The lute will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The lute's duration is extended for each note consumed.

76611.name: Tale of the Honorable Rogue
76611.description: Tale. Quote the escapades of Dougal Keane, causing nearby allies to become extraordinarily nimble with a burst of speed.

76689.name: Syncopate
76689.description: Deafening Drum releases an additional quick wave after a delay.

76695.name: Tale of the Second Scion
76695.description: Tale. Deliver the story of Aurene and the dragon cycle, rejuvenating nearby allies and increasing their incoming healing.

76746.name: Flustering Flute
76746.description:
Instrument. Play an enchanting tune with the flute, confusing enemies in front of you. Enemies in the center of the music will be dazed.
The flute will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The flute's duration is extended for each note consumed.

76850.name: Tale of the Soulkeeper
76850.description: Tale. Rouse allies with the legend of Almorra Soulkeeper, granting offensive boons.

76931.name: Crescendo
76931.description:
Strike up the band and unleash a wave of sonic magic. Instruments playing in the background contribute to the amplitude, increasing the strength of the wave.
This skill's recharge cannot be reset by other mesmer skills.

76960.name: Harmonious Harp
76960.description:
Instrument. Gain distortion and strum the harp, continuously healing nearby allies.
The harp will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The harp's duration is extended for each note consumed.

76971.name: Tale of the August Queen
76971.description: Tale. Retell how Queen Jennah protected her city in their time of need, granting allies distortion and chaos aura.

77066.name: Tale of the Tortured Mastermind
77066.description: Tale. Recall the cruelty of Scarlet Briar as you revile your target with a battery of insults, damaging their ego.

77077.name: Harmonious Harp
77077.description:
Instrument. Gain distortion and strum the harp, continuously healing nearby allies.
The harp will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The harp's duration is extended for each note consumed.

77079.name: Deafening Drum
77079.description:
Instrument. Slam the drum to release a percussive shock wave, disabling enemies. The strength of the disable increases the closer an enemy is.
The drum will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The drum's duration is extended for each note consumed.

77178.name: Tale of the Valiant Marshal
77178.description: Tale. Orate the heroism of Trahearne, calling nearby allies to action. Break their stuns and brace them for battle.

77306.name: Lively Lute
77306.description:
Instrument. Perform with your lute, sending out damaging sound waves toward an enemy and healing tones toward allies.
The lute will then consume all notes to continue playing in the background. The lute's duration is extended for each note consumed.

79359.name: Time Bomb
79359.description: Deal damage to nearby enemies with a temporal explosion.

80210.name: Detonate Chaos
80210.description: Command your chaos aura to expand and explode, granting yourself boons as you inflict conditions on enemies.
